text: Once every approver has signed off in Ariba, the purchase order is released to the supplier automatically. Buyers do not need to contact Finance to release an approved PO.
If an approved PO shows Pending release for more than one working day, open it and choose Request release. The request goes to the Procurement team, not to Finance.
From 1 September the Dubai warehouse cost centre is DXB-WH-02. The old code DXB-07 no longer accepts new purchase orders.
Purchase orders above 5,000 dollars need the cost centre manager's approval and then the Finance Controller's. Ariba routes both automatically.
If you forget to clock out, add the missing time under My Time before Sunday at midnight. Your supervisor sees the change when they approve your timesheet.
